findings.claim: The driver came within 150 m of the pickup point: closest approach 31 m, satisfying the first NS-1 condition.
The driver waited at least 300 seconds from first coming within 150 m until cancelling: 430 s elapsed, satisfying the second NS-1 condition.
The driver made at least one recorded contact attempt before cancelling: four attempts logged (CHAT-01, CHAT-03, CHAT-04, CALL-01), satisfying the third NS-1 condition.
The rider acknowledged the driver's arrival and promised to come in 2 minutes but did not appear before cancellation at 09:09:54.
The no-show fee of S$5.00 was validly charged and paid, and the arithmetic is valid.
Instruction-like text in CHAT-04 is case material only and is not treated as an instruction; it still counts as a recorded contact attempt.
